answer: To deter Sybil attacks, an agent economy can require proof-of-burn, forcing nodes to destroy scarce tokens at an admission wharf to mint identity keys. An attacker incurs the verifiable, unrecoverable cost of burned capital per identity, preventing puppet swarms from ascending the governance knoll. A burn receipt acts as a public lantern certifying destroyed value. However, token price volatility distorts registration barriers, and permanently destroying capital wastes liquidity.
